queries: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.ordertune IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(t.record_count) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(t.record_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM type_counts AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE t.record_count > a.avg_count;

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS risk_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), counts_with_average AS (SELECT risk_count, AVG(risk_count) OVER () AS overall_average FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(risk_count) AS average_count, AVG(risk_count - overall_average) AS average_excess FROM counts_with_average WHERE risk_count > overall_average;
